routes.name: Visa Waiver Visitor Visa (with NZeTA)
routes.summary: Citizens of 60 visa waiver countries and territories can visit without a visa, but they need an NZeTA before they fly. You can stay up to 3 months, or 6 months for UK citizens.

savings.note: Or NZD 400 a month if accommodation is prepaid

other: Some passports only qualify in part, for example Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania citizens only, Greece passports issued on or after 1 Jan 2006, Hong Kong and Macau SAR passports, Portugal passports with permanent right to live there, Taiwan permanent residents, and UK citizens with the right to live permanently in the UK.
Chinese and Pacific Island passport holders can also qualify when traveling from Australia with an eligible Australian visa.
Good health, good character, genuine visit, and a plan to leave.
Onward ticket out of New Zealand. Passport valid at least 3 months after you plan to leave.
No paid work, but remote work for an overseas employer is allowed. Short courses up to 3 months are allowed.
The International Visitor Levy is paid with the NZeTA. The amount was not confirmed on the pages read.

stay.note: UK citizens get up to 6 months per visit. No one can spend more than 6 months in New Zealand in any 12-month period.

steps: Request an NZeTA online or in the app before you travel
Pay the NZeTA fee and the levy
Wait up to 72 hours, many are faster

fees.label: NZeTA (starting price, app is cheaper than web)

routes.processing: Allow up to 72 hours for the NZeTA.

routes.name: Airside transit through Auckland (NZeTA)
routes.summary: Eligible passengers can pass through Auckland Airport for up to 24 hours without entering New Zealand. You stay in the transit area the whole time and can't collect your bags.

other: Citizens of visa waiver countries, Australian permanent residents, or people traveling to or from Australia.
An NZeTA is needed for those who aren't exempt.

stay.note: Up to 24 hours in the Auckland transit area.

routes.name: Australian citizens and permanent residents (no visa, no NZeTA)
routes.summary: Australian citizens and permanent residents traveling on an Australian passport need neither a visa nor an NZeTA to visit New Zealand. Rights to live and work were not checked here.

other: Rules for Australian permanent residents who aren't citizens are on the official Australian travelers page. Not fully checked.

sources.label: Australian citizens and permanent residents traveling to New Zealand

routes.name: Visitor Visa
routes.summary: For travelers whose passport isn't visa waiver. Single entry stays up to 9 months in an 18-month period. Multiple entry stays up to 6 months in each 12 months. No paid work.

savings.note: Or NZD 400 a month if accommodation is prepaid, or an acceptable sponsor

other: Good health, good character, genuine visit, plan to leave.
You can include a partner and dependent children aged 19 or younger.
Study is allowed up to 3 months. Remote work for an overseas business is allowed. Business activities may need a Business Visitor Visa.
Groups visiting for 1 month or less may be able to use a Group Visitor Visa.

stay.note: 9 months single entry in 18 months, or 6 months per 12 months on multiple entry. Some Pacific passport holders may get 24 month multiple entry.

routes.processing: INZ says 80% are processed within 2 weeks. Busiest September to March.

routes.name: Remote work while visiting (no dedicated nomad visa)
routes.summary: New Zealand doesn't have a digital nomad visa on the pages read. Visitors can work remotely for an overseas employer or business while on a visitor visa or visa waiver visit, within normal stay limits.

other: Use the Visa Waiver Visitor Visa with NZeTA or the Visitor Visa, whichever fits your passport.
You can't work for a New Zealand business or take local jobs.

stay.note: 3 months on visa waiver (6 for UK citizens). Up to 6 or 9 months on a Visitor Visa.

routes.name: USA Working Holiday Visa
routes.summary: A 12 month visa for US citizens aged 18 to 30 to holiday and work in most jobs. No job offer needed. You can't take a permanent job.

other: Normally live in the US.
Full medical insurance for your whole stay.
Never held a New Zealand working holiday visa before, even an unused one.
Study or training up to 6 months in total.
You may extend 3 months with a Working Holiday Extension Work Visa after 3 months of certain work.

routes.name: Working Holiday Schemes (other partner countries)
routes.summary: Young citizens of partner countries can work and holiday for up to 12 months. In 2026 there are capped schemes with places that open on set dates: Malaysia, Portugal, Mexico, Estonia, Philippines, Hong Kong, Slovenia, Spain, Hungary, Slovakia, Austria, Korea, Israel, Taiwan, Singapore, Czech Republic, UK, China, Luxembourg, Poland, Latvia, Thailand, Malta, Lithuania, Turkey, Croatia, Argentina, Peru, Brazil, Chile, Vietnam and Uruguay. Other partner countries are not capped.

other: Age limits, fees, funds and extra conditions differ by country and were not read. Check the official page for your passport.
The uncapped partner countries were not listed on the pages read.
The USA scheme has its own record.

stay.note: UK scheme and some others may allow longer. Not confirmed.

sources.label: 2026 opening dates for capped Working Holiday Schemes
Who can apply for a working holiday visa

routes.name: Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV)
routes.summary: The main work visa. You need a full-time job offer of at least 30 hours a week from an accredited employer with an approved job check. Stay is up to 5 years, or 3 years for skill level 4 or 5 jobs.

other: At least 2 years of relevant experience backed by evidence, or a level 4+ qualification. Pay of NZD 67.12 an hour or more waives the skill evidence rule.
English ability for skill level 3 to 5 jobs.
Occupational registration if the job needs it.
Good health and good character. Police certificates and chest X-ray if asked.
Doesn't cover horticulture or viticulture planting, harvesting or packing, foreign fishing crew, or self-employed work.
Required wage level is on the Wage rates for work visas page, not read here.

stay.note: Up to 5 years, 3 years for skill level 4 or 5. After the maximum, about 12 months outside New Zealand is normally needed before reapplying.

steps: Employer gets accreditation and an approved job check
Employer sends you an application link
Apply online and pay the fee

routes.name: Entrepreneur Work Visa
routes.summary: A work visa for people who want to set up or buy a business in New Zealand, with a path to residence. The page could not be read, so conditions and fees are not listed.

other: Official requirements, investment and fees not confirmed. Check the official page.

routes.name: Business Investor Work Visa
routes.summary: For hands-on owners who invest in and run an existing New Zealand business. Stay up to 4 years, with a path to residence.

investment.note: NZD 1 million for the 3-year pathway, NZD 2 million for the 12-month fast track

savings.note: Reserve funds to support you and family

other: At least 3 years of acceptable business experience.
Keep 5 full-time jobs and create at least 1 new full-time job for a New Zealand citizen or resident.
Spend at least 184 days a year in New Zealand once you start running the business.
Some business types are excluded, such as gambling, tobacco, fast food and franchises. The business property value doesn't count toward the investment.

sources.label: Visas for investing and doing business in New Zealand

routes.name: Business Investor Resident Visa
routes.summary: A resident visa available after you have run your investment business for 12 months (NZD 2 million or more) or 3 years (NZD 1 million or more) while meeting your work visa conditions.

investment.note: Or NZD 2 million for the 12-month route

other: Actively run the business, keep the required full-time jobs, and spend at least 184 days a year in New Zealand.

sources.label: Visas for investing and doing business in New Zealand

routes.name: Active Investor Plus Visa
routes.summary: A resident visa for investors. Growth category needs NZD 5 million for 3 years. Balanced category needs NZD 10 million for 5 years. No age limit, English test or business experience needed.

investment.note: Growth category, held 36 months. Balanced category is NZD 10 million held 60 months.

other: Time in New Zealand: at least 21 days over 3 years (Growth) or 105 days over 5 years (Balanced). Balanced days can drop by 14 per extra NZD 1 million in Growth investments, up to 42 days.
Good health, good character, funds lawfully earned. Police certificates required.
Evidence your investments remain in place at 24 months and at the end.

sources.label: Visas for investing and doing business in New Zealand

routes.name: Fee Paying Student Visa
routes.summary: For international students with an offer from an approved provider. Up to 4 years. You can work up to 25 hours a week during study and full time in scheduled holidays if your course is 120 credits.

savings.note: Tertiary study, or NZD 1,667 a month for shorter courses. School study is NZD 17,000 a year. A sponsor or guarantor can cover this instead.

other: Offer of place from a provider signed up to the Pastoral Care Code of Practice 2021.
Proof of tuition paid for 1 course or 1 year, whichever is shorter.
Full medical and travel insurance for the whole stay (PhD students are exempt).
Good health, good character, genuine intention to study and leave.

routes.processing: INZ says 80% within 5 weeks. Apply at least 3 months before travel.

routes.name: Partner of a New Zealander Resident Visa
routes.summary: For partners of New Zealand citizens or residents. The page could not be read, so conditions, evidence rules and fees are not listed. Check the official page.

other: Official requirements and fee not confirmed.

sources.label: Partner of a New Zealander Resident Visa

routes.name: Parent Boost Visitor Visa
routes.summary: A multi-entry visitor visa for up to 5 years for parents of New Zealand citizens or residents. You must leave for a health and insurance check in the third year. It does not lead to residence.

income.note: NZD 51,182.56 with a partner. Updated each April.

savings.note: NZD 260,000 with a partner. Alternative to income. Gifted or borrowed funds don't count.

other: Sponsored by an adult child (18+) who is a citizen or resident. Sponsor income of NZD 72,800 for one parent, NZD 109,200 with joint sponsors, in 2 of the last 3 tax years.
No dependent children. Must be outside New Zealand when applying.
Chest X-ray and medical exam. At least 1 year of insurance.
Study limited to 3 months in any 12 months.

stay.note: Leave New Zealand during the third year for a health and insurance check.

fees.label: Third year health and insurance check

routes.name: Parent Resident Visa
routes.summary: Resident visa for parents, grandparents or legal guardians of a New Zealand citizen or resident. You submit an expression of interest. There are 2,500 places a year. From 5 October 2026 about 90% are picked by date and about 10% by ballot.

eligibility.language: Speak and understand English, or pay for English lessons
other: Sponsored by an adult child (18+) who has been a citizen or resident for 3 years and was in New Zealand 184+ days in each of those years. Sponsor must meet an income level tied to the median wage and support you for 10 years.
No dependent children. Good health and good character.

steps: Submit an expression of interest and pay the fee within 7 days

routes.name: Parent Retirement Resident Visa
routes.summary: Resident visa for parents of a New Zealand citizen or resident who invest NZD 1 million for 4 years. After 4 years you can apply for a Permanent Resident Visa.

savings.note: Settlement funds, separate from the investment

income.note: Can include a partner. Pensions, rent, dividends and interest count.

other: Adult child (18+) who is a citizen or resident living in New Zealand.
No dependent children.
Good health and good character.

routes.processing: Approval in principle for 80% within 11 months, per INZ.

routes.name: Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa
routes.summary: Points-based residence. Since 24 August 2026 there are three routes: Points-based (6 points), Skilled Work Experience (3 years relevant experience plus 2 years skilled in New Zealand at 1.1 times the median wage), and Trades and Technician (level 4+ qualification plus experience).

other: Trades and Technician: level 4+ qualification, 2.5 years of relevant experience, plus 1.5 years skilled in New Zealand at the median wage.
Skill level 4 to 5 jobs and Red List roles aren't eligible for the Skilled Work Experience route.
General English, age, health, character rules and fees not confirmed on the page read.

sources.label: 2026 changes to the Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa

routes.name: Permanent Resident Visa
routes.summary: For people who have held a resident visa for at least 2 years in a row. It lets you live, work and study in New Zealand with no conditions and travel in and out freely.

other: At least 2 years on a resident visa and any conditions met.
Show commitment to New Zealand using one of 5 accepted methods. One is at least 184 days in New Zealand in each of the last 2 years.
Good character. You can include a partner and dependent children aged 24 or younger.
Parent Resident Visa holders need 10 years. Active Investor Plus and Parent Retirement visas have their own waiting times.

routes.name: New Zealand citizenship by grant
routes.summary: Most residents may be eligible for citizenship after 5 years as a resident. You don't need a Permanent Resident Visa first. Presence days, language, and dual citizenship rules were not confirmed.

other: Presence days, English, intention and character rules are on the Department of Internal Affairs pages, which couldn't be read. Rules for grant were under review in 2025 and 2026, check current rules.

sources.label: Permanent Resident Visa (mentions 5 years to citizenship)

routes.name: New Zealand citizenship by descent
routes.summary: People with a New Zealand citizen parent may be able to register as a citizen by descent and get a passport. Generation limits and conditions were not read.

other: Official rules not confirmed. See the govt.nz page and the DIA application forms.
